neighboring_unit_entries.title: Hankel paths realize the ASM-number determinant and yield a Catalan determinant proof
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: The r=2 specialization defines P_n and proves it equals the critical binomial determinant. A related two-stage symmetric involution shows another central-binomial Hankel determinant counts 2^n right-angle path families, while the r=1 case gives a combinatorial proof that a Catalan Hankel determinant equals one.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: C=6 determinants have alternate binomial forms, while broader smoothness patterns appear to fail
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: The five-term critical recurrence defines a moment functional whose first Hankel determinants match a higher-r binomial determinant row. Numerical factorization suggests the exceptional smooth product behavior at low orders does not persist for general binomial parameters a≥4.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: Critical Hankel determinants equal the Robbins–Rumsey product by a computer-assisted triangularization, prior work equates that product with vertically symmetric ASMs, and this paper separately models the two sides by non-intersecting and osculating paths. A direct bijection between those path/tableau families would replace the product-mediated equality.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: No direct bijection is given, and the diagonal WZ certificate needed to audit the determinant evaluation is external to the source.
